verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a terminal/SSH/mosh client for iOS; it provides shell access and code-editor integrations but has no Git platform integration for creating pull requests. This is a category error—PR creation is a GitHub/GitLab web-workflow feature, not something a terminal emulator app would surface directly (users could only do it via git CLI/gh CLI inside a remote shell, which is the remote host's tooling, not Blink's).
